_README: Per-asset findings from the Phase 2 vision pass, 16 Sep 2026. Merged by backfill.py
AFTER the rules run, so these win over any rule-derived value.
Only assets actually LOOKED AT are listed. Every value here came from inspecting the
image, not from re-reading the description. Where looking still did not establish a
value (the identity of an unnamed presenter, for instance) the field is omitted, not guessed.
slide_text is transcribed from what is legible on a screen, projector or graphic.
Nothing is inferred from a blurred or partially visible slide.

IFM-098.title: Testimonial — participant to camera in front of the IFM slide
IFM-098.description: A workshop participant stands smiling in front of the branded "Investing for Mummies" slide with its multitasking-mum graphic, speaking directly to camera — her own account of the session, not a presenter segment.
IFM-098._why: CORRECTED 19 Sep 2026. The user spotted this in the Media Kit: it is a STUDENT giving a testimonial, not Hiral. The original description asserted "Founder Hiral Goel stands smiling", so every automatic check agreed -- including hiral_named, which looks for her name in the text. The name was there; the text was simply wrong. This is the failure mode no rule catches: a confident, specific, incorrect description. Removed from the kit; person and format corrected.
